newsitem.title: UK: Swell shuts Novorossiisk port after brief respite.
newsitem.headline: Swell shuts Novorossiisk port after brief respite.

text.p: Russia's main oil export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea shut again in the early hours of Thursday after reopening briefly Wednesday evening, a reliable shipping source said.

The port, which closed midday on Monday due to bad weather, reopened at 2000 hours local time on Wednesday allowing two crude tankers to berth but closed again just over four hours later because of high swell.
The source said the outlook was no better, with bad weather forecast for Thursday afternoon as winds increase to Force 9.
Three large crude tankers were at anchor outside the port.
Other Black Sea ports at Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally, as was Latvia's port of Ventspils on the Baltic.
